component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.capture.listener
component.documentation: The capture listeners. CaptureItemListener, synchronous, in the transaction of the change, as the person who makes it: an item is received when it is created in its inbox with its file; a person confirms, corrects or rejects one while it waits; and nothing else of the server's changes. CaptureIntakeListener, in the background once the item's creation has committed, as the system: classifies, extracts, matches and files, or queues it for a person. CaptureAuditWriter writes the add-on's entries to the platform's audit once their transaction has committed. No Automation operation: a person reaches it by uploading and by editing an item, as every client does.
